title: Native locally finite function coefficients are the finite-subextension condensed coefficients
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime and $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ with its extended $\ell$-adic norm topology. Let $C$ be the commutative condensed ring whose sections on a profinite set $S$ are the continuous maps $S\to\Omega$ with image in one finite intermediate extension of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, with pointwise operations [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed]. For any scheme $T$, let $p_T^*C$ be its coefficient inverse image on the small pro-etale site [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $B_T$ be the ring sheaf of [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework]: on $V\to T$ its sections are continuous functions $|V|\to\Omega$ such that each point has an open neighbourhood on which the image spans a finite-dimensional $\mathbf Q_\ell$-subspace, with precomposition restrictions and pointwise operations. There is a canonical isomorphism of sheaves of commutative rings
$$\theta_T:p_T^*C\xrightarrow{\sim}B_T.$$
For a finite intermediate field $E\subset\Omega$, write $C(-,E)=\underline E$ for the condensed ring of continuous $E$-valued functions [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]; the composite $p_T^*C(-,E)\to p_T^*C\xrightarrow{\theta_T}B_T$ of $\theta_T$ with the pullback of the inclusion is, under the canonical continuous-function realization $p_T^*C(-,E)\cong(V\mapsto C(|V|,E))$ [lem-weil-pbc-continuous-coefficient-realizations], postcomposition of functions with $E\hookrightarrow\Omega$. For every scheme morphism $h:T'\to T$, the square of ring-sheaf maps $\eta_h:p_T^*C\to h_*p_{T'}^*C$ (the coefficient map of [sk-def-sfb-coefficient-morphisms], mate of the canonical pullback comparison) and $B_T\to h_*B_{T'}$ commutes with $\theta_T$ and $h_*\theta_{T'}$; the bottom map is precomposition of functions. No Noetherianity or separatedness hypothesis on $T$ is required.
